name: Apart Ebene
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The **Gasthof Apart Ebene** is located in the **Ebene** district of Ischgl. The base station of the **Silvretta-Bahn** is easily reachable on foot. The establishment combines guest rooms with holiday apartments. In the hotel’s own restaurant, traditional Tyrolean dishes are served. A **sauna area** completes the offer. The accommodation provides an ideal starting point for activities in both summer and winter. Parking spaces are available for a fee.
